decisions.text: Update source: package.json and CHANGELOG.md on GitHub main via raw.githubusercontent.com (no API rate limit); notify only, never auto-install; daily cached check, CA_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 opts out.
Polish contract measured on master first: agent window ran past the bottom at 1280x720 and 1024x640, stayed off screen after a resize, phone tap targets under 32 px.

Merged update, polish-office, polish-lanes (all ready, 0 fix rounds); lead fixes after the eye review: phone bottom sheet, portrait tablet layout, update busy state, long-notes popover, empty Office state, tiles 2x2, phone lane bar; 0.3.0 released locally; all 30 checks pass
